# MakerHint

> Maps of a growing list of jobs in the United States and how they are done: workflows, pains, workarounds, constraints, judgment calls, team dynamics, limits, improvisation, vocabulary and open questions. For AI agents and people building software for a profession.

MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://43xkx1udl2btioly8.apify.actor/mcp?ch=llms  (Apify API token as Bearer token)
Free tools: list_niches, preview_role_map, request_niche, request_verification. Paid tools (0.05 USD per call): get_role_map, ask_role_map.
The maps describe work practice and give no professional advice.
